messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to lock prioritization for catalog lifecycle (onboarding, pin exceptions, deprecation windows) for the next roadmap slice. Three customer asks plus infra limits. Can we decide gating and default gracepath today?

Eli: From infra: bench slots ~30/day right now. Autoscaler improvements land mid-June, which should bump capacity ~20%. Pinning heavy models increases steady capacity needs (esp for Dedicated). We need an estimate of token throughput cost per pinned model.

Samira: For eval gating I'd propose: latency at 95th pct under target, embedding cosine >= 0.8 vs baseline on our core 1k prompts, and a 100-sample stability audit per model-region. For low-risk customers we can reduce sampling to 30 examples.

Priya: SE perspective: Customer A + C asked for pins until they finish migration (3–6 months). We usually avoid long pins; offering a compat-shim + migration credits usually works. If they insist, we need playbooks for migration and a comms template.

Jonas: Sales note — B will not accept <90-day window. If we force a short timeline we risk renewal. They want a soft-deprecation plan + canary lanes.

Maya: Proposal: 'Gracepath 90/180' — default pin = 90 days; extend to 180 with SLA/credit and compat-shim opt-in. Launch gates: infra bench capacity (post-autoscaler), eval gating, migration playbook & comms. Pilot with 2 customers first. Thoughts?

Eli: Sounds reasonable. Pilot is important. Also need a 'pin API' to revoke/extend pins + rollout status dashboard so SEs can see who is pinned where. I can scope the dashboard and API; think ~6w to MVP.

Samira: We can automate the stability audits if customers provide labeled prompt sets. Also recommend an automated regression alert (email + Slack) if quality drops >2% vs pinned baseline on ongoing sampled traffic.

Priya: I'll draft a migration playbook (data export, SDK switch, feature-flag timeline, rollback steps) and a comms checklist. Can get v0 by Friday.

Jonas: Can we offer temporary dedicated capacity as a paid buffer for customers who need extra runway? Sales could sell that as a migration-risk mitigation add-on.

Maya: Good call. Action items: Priya — playbook v0; Samira — formalize gating thresholds & test harness; Eli — scope pin API + dashboard; Jonas — list pilot customers and ask about paid buffer/credits. I'll schedule a 30-min decision sync next Wed. :calendar:

deploy-bot: Reminder — infra deploy window Jun 12–13; bench availability may be reduced that week. :warning:

Maya: Noted, moving decision sync to Jun 20 to avoid deploy window. Thanks all, closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
